title: The green bridge over Highway 46
text: A green footbridge crosses Highway 46 at Lost Hills, built after a pedestrian was killed trying to cross the road. Its shape is meant to look like a lizard, and it funnels the rain that lands on it to the sides to be collected. The Wonderful Company paid for it.

s2.title: Lost Hills, California
s2.quote: After the death of a pedestrian trying to cross the highway, a green pedestrian bridge was constructed spanning California Highway 46. It was funded by the Wonderful Company. Its design resembles the shape of a lizard and is able to funnel any precipitation that lands on it to the sides to allow for collection.
